headlines.title: Transnet sets global freight rail record with 696-wagon train
headlines.summary: The empty train completed a test run on the Saldanha-to-Northern Cape iron ore line, with operational data set to inform future heavy-haul strategies and corridor capacity.

headlines.title: The fossil fuel comeback is here
headlines.summary: The US is building more fossil fuel infrastructure than it has in a decade while renewable energy growth slows down, a new report shows. Electricity demand is also climbing faster than it has in more than a decade with more data centers, factories, and electric vehicles plugging into the grid.

concept.title: AI Governance & the EU AI Act
concept.body: Regulators increasingly require transparency, documentation, and risk classification for AI systems. Compliance is shifting from a legal afterthought to part of how you design and deploy.
concept.takeaway: Name an owner, document your models and data, and monitor use before you scale.
